commands.command:
set -eu
tmp_file=$(mktemp /usr/local/bin/.inventory-maintenance.XXXXXX)
cat > "$tmp_file" <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT_EOF
chown root:root "$tmp_file"
chmod 0755 "$tmp_file"
mv "$tmp_file" /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
/bin/sh -n /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
stat -c 'path=%n type=%F mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s' /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
sed -n '1,5p' /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

set -eu
service_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/systemd/system/.inventory-maintenance.service.XXXXXX)
timer_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/systemd/system/.inventory-maintenance.timer.XXXXXX)
cat > "$service_tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run inventory maintenance

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
StandardOutput=append:/var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
StandardError=append:/var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
ANTRIEB_SERVICE_EOF
cat > "$timer_tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_TIMER_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run inventory maintenance daily at 02:15

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:15:00
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1s
RandomizedDelaySec=0
Unit=inventory-maintenance.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_TIMER_EOF
chown root:root "$service_tmp" "$timer_tmp"
chmod 0644 "$service_tmp" "$timer_tmp"
mv "$service_tmp" /etc/systemd/system/inventory-maintenance.service
mv "$timer_tmp" /etc/systemd/system/inventory-maintenance.timer
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-maintenance.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-maintenance.timer
printf 'service_unit_written\n'
printf 'timer_unit_written\n'
set -eu; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now inventory-maintenance.timer; systemctl is-enabled inventory-maintenance.timer; systemctl is-active inventory-maintenance.timer
